notes.title: Patch 1.0.6.1 - Fixing The AMD Driver Crash
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28782789/1bd1a473e552d1c1d0926574aa34c8781876d469.jpg[/img]

Hello all,

We've just released a new beta patch fixes problems with the latest AMD drivers, as well as addressing a variety of other issues with the game. 

If you followed our guide on how to revert your drivers, you may now re-enable the AMD driver auto-updates, as the issue this caused has been fixed. 


[h1][b]Patch notes:[/b][/h1]

[b]Driver Issues:[/b]
[list]
[*]Provided a fix for AMD driver crash, in support of an AMD driver update.
[*]Fixed a random crash that would occur on La Vuelta
[/list]

[b]Gameplay:[/b]
[list]
[i]Sprinting[/i]
[*] Fixed drafting too high during sprints. 
[*] Fixed a bug that made it too easy to escape when Free Effort was set on big effort
[i]Downhill[/i]
[*] Fixed downhill issues where it was impossible to escape
[i]Other[/i]
[*] Added World Championship as an objective
[/list]

[b]User Interace[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a refresh button to the Teammate Objectives menu
[*] New Race days filter added to the preparation page. 
[*] The in-race "Custom Selection" filter has been removed.
[*] AI observations will now be displayed as tooltips.
[*] Fixed custom time gaps showing a white sprite.
[*] Fixed the indirect order panel UI so that it is always visible above the rest of the HUD. Will no longer go out of the screen bounds.
[/list]

[b]Controls[/b]
[list]
[*] Removed the option to select the first rider in a race. 
[/list]

[b]Mods[/b]
[list]
[*] The game will now check if you use or have submitted a custom database, and will warn you that if it is incomplete or corrupted, that it might cause in-game issues.
[/list]

[b]Save System[/b]
[list]
[*]Added a failsafe folder in AppData, in the case that "My Documents" cannot be found.
[*]Added error messages for when the game fails to create or retrieve files from AppDate or My Documents folders.
[/list]

Please let us know if you continue to have any issues by emailing support@focus-home.com and describing the issue. 

Thank you,

The Pro Cycling Manager team

notes.title: Patch 1.0.5.5 - Save Games Fix
notes.content:
[img]https://image.noelshack.com/fichiers/2017/31/4/1501763803-pcm-07-nologo.jpg[/img]

[b]Hey everyone, we've discovered that the issue making all the jerseys the same is linked to popular mod, WorldDB. As this is a third-party mod, we are unable to do anything about the issue. 

Your jersey files no longer exist in that dB on your old saves. We have, however, worked with the developers of this mod,, and they have managed to restore your old jersey files, allowing you to keep your saves. 

For this to work, you will need to have jersey files in double (old and new) and to download another 10GB update. If you'd prefer to not have to download that 10GB update, you'll need to start a new career with the new jersey files only. 

For more information, please take a look at the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=946564982]World DB Steam Workshop page[/url]. 

Many thanks to BenjiNaesen and SonicDonkey4425 for helping us identify and fix this issue.
[/b]

----------------------------------------------------

Hello all,

We've just released a new beta patch that brings a fix for save games to Pro Cycling Manager 2017. 

You can access the beta branch of updates by following the helpful guide we've written here.

You can find the full patch notes below.

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed saves system: Some players were unable to save
[*]Fixed invalid reference files in the Database Editor.
[*]Fixed default language: Now, if the game doesn't correctly detect a language, it will default to displaying the game in English. 

[/list]

Please let us know if you continue to have any issues by emailing support@focus-home.com and describing the issue. 

Thank you,

The Pro Cycling Manager team

[*]Fixed invalid reference files in the Database Editor.
[*]Fixed default language: Now, if the game doesn't correctly detect a language, it will default to displaying the game in English.

notes.title: Update 1.0.5.1 - AI improvement & Bug Fixes
notes.content:
[img]https://image.noelshack.com/fichiers/2017/26/4/1498747802-pcm17-3.gif[/img]

Hi everyone,

We've just released a patch that improve AI behaviour in Pro Cycling Manager 2017, as well as various fixes and improvements.

We continue to collect your feedback on issues with PCM17. Thank you for your help in making this game the best cycling manager it can be!
 
[h1][b]AI[/b][/h1]

[b]Breakaways[/b]
[list][*]AI are now less quick to react when there is an attack or an acceleration on flat areas.
[*]The draft effect has been tweaked to ease a breakaway a little.
Thus, it should now be a little easier to break away in Pro Cyclist mode.[/list]
[b]Leaders’ behavior[/b]
[list][*]Leaders will now use their energy better so their attacks will be more effective.
[*]Strong leaders now stop their attack if too many riders are following.[/list]
Thus, leaders should now act a bit more aggressively and more realistically.

[b]Other[/b]
[list][*]Selection on cobblestones is now more effective.
[*]A rider is now less protected by another rider when they are "far" from each other. Protection” is now more realistic in that it was too easy to follow an attack of a rider that was already too far ahead.[/list]
[h1][b]LEVEL DESIGN[/b][/h1]
[list][*]California Tour stages have been updated with new graphics and actual stages and is now available in Cya World Tour[/list]
[h1][b]BLOCKING ISSUES[/b][/h1]
[list][*]Fixed a very rare case of blocking but in ITT when an injured rider was kicked out of a race without notifying the player.[/list]
[h1][b]MINOR BUGS[/b][/h1]
[list][*]Fixed a bug allowing a rider to register for a race while being ill.
[*]Fixed the missing “Accept” button issues in multiplayer.
[*]Fixed World Tour race news received without a wildcard.
[*]Safe mode now fixes missing/glitching cursor issues.
[*]Improved cursor size for high resolution (4K)
[*]Missing riders pictures have now been updated.
[*]AG2R team has been updated (shirts and FR/BE champions).[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.0.4.1 - 4K Support
notes.content:
[img]https://image.noelshack.com/fichiers/2017/26/2/1498557165-pcm17-1.gif[/img]

Hi everyone,

We've just released a patch that implements 4K support in Pro Cycling Manager 2017, as well as various fixes and improvements.

We continue to collect your feedback on issues with PCM17. Thank you for your help in making this game the best cycling manager it can be!

[h1][b]Graphics[/b][/h1]
[list][*]4K resolution support has been implemented.[/list]
[h1][b]Level Design[/b][/h1]
[list][*]Trophy of Abu Dhabi stages have been updated with new graphics and actual stages.[/list]
[h1][b]Multiplayer[/b][/h1]
[list][*]Ping display has been updated.
[*]Fixed blocking bug when kicking a player during the team selection.[/list]
[h1][b]AI[/b][/h1]
[list][*]Fixed sprints with a small group of riders (10-15 riders) – AI’s reaction to  an attack at less than 3km before the finish line was too slow, letting the player take advantage.
[*]Fixed AI issue with attackers stopping their escape after the attack more than 50km from the finish line on Paris-Roubaix.
[*]HIL stat has been tweaked to improve performances of Punchers who are bad Climbers (e.g.: Gilbert)
[list][*]Yellow energy bar is decreasing slower
[*]MO stat is 100% used on a slope of 7% (instead of 5% before)
[*]Effort from which the HIL stat acts at 100% : 96% (previously: 100%)
[*]In a uphill sprint, Punchers will increase their effort to use more their HIL stat
[*]Punchers who are bad Climbers are better evaluated on hilly classics.[/list]
[*]TTT issue fixed: teams no longer stop in the middle of a race
[*]Fixed Ai rosters: 2 leaders max per team on classic races
[*]The least efficient leaders will no longer stick to the head of the peloton and form a wall, thus allowing favorites in a bad position to come back in the front.[/list]

Please let us know if you continue to have any issues by emailing support@focus-home.com and describing the issue. 

Thank you,
The Pro Cycling Manager team

notes.title: Update Three - 1.0.3.4 - Race Calendar Issue Fix
notes.content:
[img]https://image.noelshack.com/fichiers/2017/26/4/1498747802-pcm17-3.gif[/img]

Hello all,

We've also just released a patch that handles the race calendar issue that was mentioned in the previous update. Players will now no longer be forced to participate in races that their rider is not scheduled for. 

This patch also enables various other tweaks and fixes in PCM 17. We continue to collect your feedback on issues with PCM17, and thank you for your help in making this game the best cycling manager it can be. 

Please find the changelog below:

[h1][b]Bug fixes:[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue with the race calendar in Pro Cyclist mode, that would force the rider to do every race his team has planned, even if he was not registered for it.
[*]Fixed an issue with the CYA World Tour team points not being counted.
[*]Fixed issues with Russian characters in profile names.
[*]Fixed a crash when clicking the on the Options button.
[*]Fixed a crash when closing/exiting the game.
[/list]

Please let us know if you continue to have any issues by emailing support@focus-home.com and describing the issue.

notes.title: Update Two - 1.0.3.2 - Race Calendar Issue
notes.content:
[img]https://image.noelshack.com/fichiers/2017/26/2/1498557165-pcm17-1.gif[/img]

Hello all,

We are aware that you are currently experiencing game breaking issues with the race calendar in Pro Cyclist mode forcing you to participate in races you haven't enrolled in.

We are actively working on a fix for this and hopefully we will be able to release it by the end of the week.

In the meantime, we'd like to offer a workaround that a player has found and that will allow you to continue your Pro Cyclist game playing only your selected races, with special thanks to user Jo12, who discovered this workaround. 
[list] 
[*]Once you're satisfied with your planning, instead of clicking on "Continue", click on today's date to open the actual calendar, click on the next scheduled race and click on "Advance to this date”.
[*]Only your scheduled races appear on the calendar. Thus you can make sure your race schedule is respected.
[*][b]DO NOT use the "Continue" button or the issue will return.[/b]
[/list]

We apologize for the inconvenience and hope this will help you keep playing while waiting for the patch.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

We've [b]also[/b] just released a new patch that handles various tweaks and fixes for PCM 17. We continue to collect your feedback on issues with PCM17, and thank you for your help in making this game the best cycling manager it can be.

[/list]

Please let us know if you continue to have any issues by emailing support@focus-home.com and describing the issue. 

Thank you,

The Pro Cycling Manager team

notes.title: Update One - Patch 1.0.3.1
notes.content:
[img]https://image.noelshack.com/fichiers/2017/26/2/1498554706-pcm17-3.gif[/img]

Hello all,

We've been hard at work addressing issues in Pro Cycling Manager 2017 since release. In this latest small patch, please find the latest issues that we have corrected.

[h1][b]Saving Progress Hotfix[/b][/h1]

We've discovered the cause of an issue that was stopping players from being able to save their progress. All you need to do to fix the issue will be to restart the game, and then click on your profile on the bottom of the main screen, and then select "Connect with [Profile Username]".

[h1][b]Additional Fixes:[/b][/h1]

[b]Crashes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed a crash relating to the player profile trying to connect.
[*]Fixed a random crash related to the rosters in Pro Cyclist mode.
[*]The game no longer crashes when progressing to a new season in solo mode, on the 24th of October, when creating a new generation of cyclists.
[*]Fixed a possible crash when clicking on the Objectives tab, where the game would crash if you had deleted a race previously set as a customized objective for one of your teammates.
[*]Fixed a possible crash with rosters in Pro Cyclist mode.
[/list]
[b]Blocks[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug that was preventing the player from starting the race in Istrian Trophy TT
[/list]
[b]Graphical bugs[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed various graphical bugs 
[*]Fixed the camera in the podium cutscene
[*]Fixed black screen when starting a 3D race in multiplayer
[/list]
[b]Upcoming fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Crashes related to clan options.
[*]Bugs with leaders and sprinters in final massive sprints
[/list]
Please let us know if you continue to have any issues by emailing support@focus-home.com and describing the issue. 

Thank you,

The Pro Cycling Manager team
